fullText: A 2026 modeling paper estimated a median human lifespan of about 156 years under a highly specific assumption: every other modeled aging mechanism was removed, leaving somatic mutations as the remaining limit. While they don't predict we'll live to 156, it is an attempt to estimate what might become limiting after other causes of aging are solved.
